title: reduce_sum returns wrong / non-deterministic totals
description: Block-level tree reduction sums an array of 1.0f values and should return 1048576.0. GPU returns values below this (often 4096 * blocks * varying fraction) and results vary from run to run when the block finishes at different offsets. Suspect a synchronization issue between the halving rounds.
expected_behavior: STATUS: PASS with GPU sum equal to CPU reference (max_abs_err < 0.5).
actual_behavior: STATUS: FAIL_NUMERIC — GPU_RESULT samples diverge from CPU_REFERENCE by hundreds to thousands, and different runs give different sums (RUN_SPREAD non-zero).
reproduction_hints: The kernel writes to shared memory then loops without __syncthreads() between rounds.
Between shared memory writes and reads by other threads, a __syncthreads() barrier is mandatory on hygon DCU (wave = 64, block = 256 spans 4 waves).
Fix candidate: add __syncthreads() before and inside the reduction loop.
